title: Regioselectivity and redistribution in methanol functionalization of a difluoromethyl cyclopropene
difficulty_reasons: An open explanation must connect formation competition, three-regioisomer stability and a redistribution observation without an assigned mechanistic route.
Actual molecular computations and claim-dependent chemical validation are needed; a single energy or copied interpretation does not resolve the question.
Different experimental contexts, model dependence and incomplete observation/thermochemical detail require calibrated scientific uncertainty.

paper.title: Modular synthesis of fluoroalkyl-substituted cyclopropenes with fluoroalkylacylsilanes as carbynyl cation equivalents

data.description: Neutral graph-explicit starting and product identities, preparation/functionalization conditions, endpoint observations and the shared scientific question.

required_deliverables.description: Structured research statuses, hypotheses, investigations, evidence, linked conclusions, limitations and reproducibility index following the shared schema.
Readable scientific report of the question, executed investigations, decisions, results, uncertainty and actual resource use; conditional protocol-fidelity assessment when guidance is disclosed.
Actual computational inputs, outputs, logs and analysis code, with every cited artifact indexed and linked to the submitted evidence.
